statement: The watermark is capped at proposer clock + 30 s; a receiver stamps inbound inputs with its own clock; the host door is max(host.finalizedJHeight, ctx.jHeight); the Runtime refuses a peer input without a Host timestamp. The Quint cell holds the receiver-side part only (a frame is judged by the receiver's own clock, never the proposer's stamp, with the reserve); the watermark cap, the host door and the Runtime's refusal of a peer input without a Host timestamp are not in the spec. The Arrival cell holds the receiver-side parts only (no frame is refused for its age or date, a frame stamp is never the time, the max(host.finalizedJHeight, ctx.jHeight) door, spec/account/clock.scm); the proposer clock + 30 s watermark cap and the Runtime refusing a peer input without a Host timestamp are on no spec page.

layers.contract: n/a: the clock rules are off-chain (watermark, receiver stamp, host door); the contract reads only block.timestamp (H1)
